# $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/systemd/user/fastener-restore.service
# Installed by "fastener install-restore"; "fastener install-restore --uninstall" removes it.
[Unit]
Description=Fastener: restore remote bridges after a reboot
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/opt/fastener/bin/fastener restore
Environment=FASTENER_CONFIG_DIR=$CONFIG
Environment=FASTENER_STATE_DIR=$STATE
# Monitors started with the setsid launcher must outlive this one-shot unit.
KillMode=process

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
